# laravelforge_site_deploy_hook (Data Source)

Fetches the deployment-trigger (deploy-hook) URL for a Laravel Forge site.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site whose deploy hook is fetched.

### Read-Only

- `url` (String) The deployment-trigger URL for the site.
